claim: Two self-inflicted patterns with measured costs: (1) a 3-habit cap held for eight years under a 'free forever' listing — 180 cap complaints (mean 2.43), 41.0% of all one-stars, 27 'misleading free' reviews at mean 1.85 (the angriest cluster), while the product's own widget holds four rows; (2) an unbounded in-app rating prompt from May 2023 that tripled review volume with contentless 5★ (297 in 44 days), generated 50 complaints including 10 one-stars and 17 reviews written only to make it stop, and diluted every later negative-theme rate so that 'nothing was fixed; the complaint is being out-shouted by prompted praise'
